svg.text: ESP32-S3 minimum system | cross-page nets use global same-name labels
All 57 package terminals explicit; internal Flash / PSRAM / crystal retained
MLX90393 + LSM6DSOX | I2C and interrupt nets continue by label
Separate data-ready signals; 3.3 V; MLX 0x10 and IMU 0x6A
Each 100 nF capacitor at its own supply pin; common GND.
GPIO4 = MLX DRDY; GPIO5 = IMU INT1. Stamp samples separately.
Side-entry USB-C data/power | USB 2.0 device, no PD
USB 2.0 device / no PD; independent CC pull-downs; USB VBUS detection
VBUS is 5 V only; see Q2 for isolated VBUS detection.
USB-only cold start under the 100 mA pre-enumeration limit requires testing.
Protected 1S battery | about 2 h target | charge disabled by default
Charge disabled by default; NTC link DNP until the cell and temperature network are approved
ISET about 103 mA typical; confirm cell rating and tolerances. BAT/OUT caps require DC-bias review.
EN2 EN1: 00 = USB100; 01 = USB500 after host permits; 11 = suspend. No automatic 500 mA assumption.
Switch OFF turns off 3V3 and disables charge. It does not disconnect the battery protection/charger.
ROUND SENSOR / SCH-A1 / 05 RF + BATTERY + DEBUG
Ceramic antenna option | cell/NTC interface | recovery pads
No PCB footprints bound in SCH-A1; geometry studies do not cover this revision
Use 50 ohm feed; matching values require the actual PCB, enclosure, battery and hand grip.
Antenna keepout applies through the board stack and to components on BOTH sides.
R16 is OPEN as delivered: charging is inhibited. Choose the battery and NTC network before fitting it.
GPIO7 reads VBUS_PRESENT_N. Firmware must detach USB when VBUS is absent and handle USB suspend.
GPIO6 battery ADC is intentionally unconnected pending switched sensing; no off-state back-power path.
Cell protection remains required. Brownout / low-battery cutoff and USB-only boot need bench verification.
SCHEMATIC REVIEW REV SCH-A1 | Footprints / PCB / RF tuning / cell NTC / hardware tests pending
